name: Bengali Hate Speech Dataset
description: A fine-grained Bengali hate speech dataset created for detecting hate and offensive language across social media platforms like Facebook and YouTube. It categorizes statements into political, personal, religious, geopolitical, and gender-abusive hate with expert linguist and native-speaker validation.
